topic: Ego-centric 数据在具身模型训练中的问题与困难

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): 第一视角人类视频进入具身训练时，还会以 human video、first-person demonstration、hand-object interaction、pseudo-action、latent action 和 ego-to-robot 等术语出现。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-robot-learning
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"egocentric video" AND (all:"robot learning" OR all:"robot manipulation")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 直接覆盖第一视角视频用于机器人学习。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-first-person-demonstration
dynamic_suggestions.why: 补充不使用 egocentric 术语的第一视角论文。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-human-video-policy
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"human video" AND (all:"robot policy" OR all:"imitation learning")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖从人类视频学习机器人策略的主线。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-ego-to-robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖跨本体迁移与 embodiment gap。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hand-object-interface
dynamic_suggestions.why: 手—物交互是将人类第一视角视频转成机器人可执行表征的常见接口。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-latent-pseudo-action
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"latent action" OR all:"pseudo action") AND (all:"human video" OR all:egocentric) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖无原生机器人动作标签时的替代监督。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-trajectory-extraction
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND (all:"6DoF trajectory" OR all:"object trajectory" OR all:"hand pose") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖从原始第一视角视频恢复运动轨迹及其噪声问题。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-observability-limit
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND (all:occlusion OR all:contact OR all:"camera motion" OR all:visibility) AND (all:robot OR all:manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖遮挡、接触不可观测和相机自运动等数据缺陷。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-vla-pretraining
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:egocentric AND (all:VLA OR all:"vision language action") AND (all:pretraining OR all:"pre-training")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖第一视角视频用于 VLA 预训练的直接证据。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-training-challenges-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (egocentric OR first-person) human video robot learning embodiment gap action labels occlusion
dynamic_suggestions.why: 发现 API 元数据可能漏掉的挑战型论文。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egocentric-robot-terms-web
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs egocentric human video robot policy 2025 2026
dynamic_suggestions.why: 校准近一年方法名与数据处理术语。

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): HumanEgo 使用 entity-level hand-object interaction 与 dense auxiliary objectives 描述 ego-to-robot transfer。
arxiv calibration (high): EgoScaler 使用 6DoF object manipulation trajectories、raw egocentric videos、noisy or incomplete trajectories 与 VLA pre-training。
